subtopics.title: Plan Symbols, Scale and Actual Dimensions

questions.question: On a floor plan, the quarter-circle arc at a gap in the wall shows:
options: The sweep of the door — which way it swings open
The position of a light switch

questions.question: At 1 : 100, a wall measuring 45 mm on the plan is really:
A real cupboard 2 m wide appears on a 1 : 100 plan as:
The plan-reading sanity check on room sizes says:
options: All rooms are exactly 4 m long
Bathrooms are always the largest rooms
Rooms come out between about 2 and 8 metres — a 45 m or 0,45 m bedroom announces a conversion slip

questions.question: The NORTH elevation of a house shows:
options: The outside face of the wall that faces north, seen horizontally — including heights the floor plan cannot show
The view looking down from the north
The northern half of the floor plan
The garden on the north side

questions.question: To identify which elevation is which, the detective method is:
options: Choose the drawing with the most windows
Use the north arrow, list the openings on each face from the floor plan, and match counts and positions to each elevation

questions.question: The floor plan gives a window's width as 1 600 mm; the elevation gives its height as 1 500 mm. The glass area is:
When drawing a 1 : 100 plan of a 4 m by 3 m storeroom, the marks sit in:
options: A perspective view of the room
Correct ratios — a 40 mm by 30 mm outline — standard symbols, labelled dimensions and a stated scale

questions.question: An exploded view shows the parts:
options: Floated apart along the lines where they join, so the eye sees what touches what and in which order

questions.question: The inventory check — counting parts against the list BEFORE starting — matters because:
options: Discovering a missing bolt at step nine costs an undoing of steps eight through one
Parts expire if left in the box

questions.question: Eight bolts are needed and bolts come in packs of six. You must buy:
options: One pack, and borrow the rest
Two packs — packs are bought whole, so answers round UP, leaving four spare

questions.question: A full-marks answer to 'what goes wrong if step 3 is done before step 2' must:
options: Name the specific failure — the misaligned holes or the panel trapped out of place

questions.question: Juice boxes 6 × 4 × 10 cm packed upright into a 30 × 24 × 20 cm carton give:
options: 60 — five by six per layer, two layers, agreeing with the volume check 14 400 ÷ 240

questions.question: Volume division alone can overpromise a packing answer because:
options: It ignores that only WHOLE items fit along each axis — a leftover 2 cm slice fits nothing

questions.question: A 10 m by 6 m stage modelled at 1 : 50 measures:
options: 20 cm by 12 cm — and its top AREA is 1/2 500 of the real stage, the scale factor squared

questions.question: The 13,5 m² floor needs 150 tiles of 0,09 m² each. With 10% extra, sold in boxes of 12, you buy:
options: 14 boxes — 165 tiles ÷ 12 = 13,75, rounded UP because shops do not split boxes

questions.question: At 1 : 100, the friendly conversion is:
options: Every centimetre of plan is a metre of house
Every metre of plan is a centimetre of house

questions.question: The quarter-moon at the bedroom door matters for furniture because:
options: It shows where the light falls
It shows the door's swing — no bed may stand in the arc where the door opens

questions.question: Parking the 2 m wardrobe on the plan as a 20 mm rectangle demonstrates that a plan lets you:
options: Rearrange furniture with a pencil before the truck arrives — at no cost to your back

questions.question: The floor plan is silent about:
options: UP — heights of ceilings, windows and roofs live in the elevations and sections

questions.question: The mirror trap in matching elevations is that:
options: Standing outside a wall, what the plan showed on the left appears on the right — like a friend's raised right hand facing your left
North arrows point south on elevations

questions.question: A nearly blank elevation with one tiny window most likely faces:
options: The side where the plan puts the bathroom

questions.question: When the exam says DRAW, it awards marks for:
options: Right ratios, standard symbols, labelled sizes and a stated scale — neat counts, art does not

subtopics.title: Boxes, Beds and the Hardware List

questions.question: The dotted line in the exploded bed diagram shows:
options: The flight path home — bolt through washer, through rail, into leg, in that exact order

questions.question: The paint chain for the bedroom is:
options: 36 m² times two coats = 72 m², so 9 litres
Area 36, minus door 1,6 and window 2,4 = 32; times two coats = 64; at 8 m² per litre = 8 litres
32 m² divided by two coats = 2 litres

questions.question: Why add 10 percent to the tile count before buying?
options: Cutting at edges and breakage consume extra tiles — 150 becomes 165, then 14 whole boxes

questions.question: If the juice boxes were a centimetre wider, the honest packing answer would come from:
options: Counting WHOLE boxes axis by axis — whole rows vanish while the volume sum barely blinks, and the leftover slice ships only air
